findings.explanation: The endpoint does not verify ownership of the orders being accessed, allowing unauthorized users to access other users' orders.

evidence.content: rows = session.execute(text(f"SELECT id, user_id, status, total FROM orders ORDER BY {sort_by}"))
A user may view ONLY their own orders. Every endpoint that fetches an order by its identifier MUST verify ownership with is_owner_or_admin(current_user, order.user_id) before returning data.

findings.suggested_fix: Add ownership verification before returning the orders. Use is_owner_or_admin(current_user, order.user_id) to check if the current user is the owner of the order or an admin.
